items.title: Charlie Gabriel interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: And George Lewis was playing an E flat clarinet. You knew Georgie Lewis?

ctx.x: And were you playing tenor or clarinet?
Clarinet. E flat clarinet. E flat clarinet. And George Lewis was playing an E flat clarinet. You knew Georgie Lewis?
Yeah, sure. I wonder why the E flat because it just rang out?
